claims.claim: Naive override rate overstates the true correction rate when accepting requires a re-pick.
claims.evidence: pick-to-accept: override rate 15.5% vs true corrections 10.2% (20 seeds: confirm-as-is 36.3% ± 2.4%).

claims.claim: 'A third to half of overrides are confirm-as-is.'
claims.evidence: Lab default 34.4%; across the sensitivity grid 19%–76%. The share depends on hold rate and how often correct items are opened.
claims.post_change: Keep 'a third to half' as a production observation; add that the size depends on hold rate and review habits.

claims.claim: NEW — bulk 'set category' hides real errors, not just adds noise.
claims.evidence: true corrections captured (mean over seeds): one-click 10.7% vs pick-to-accept with bulk-set 9.7% — bulk-set stamped wrong labels as human-confirmed.
claims.post_change: Add: bulk-set doesn't just inflate overrides, it stamps wrong labels as human-confirmed.

claims.claim: The reviewed subset overstates error (people open what looks wrong).
corrections ÷ all drafts is a lower bound.
claims.evidence: default 10.2% ≤ true 20.1%; holds in all 54 sensitivity cells.

claims.claim: A blind stratified audit (20 per bin per week) recovers the true error.
claims.evidence: with adjudication: 95% CI covers truth 95% of runs, bias +0.0pp, ±3.1pp after 4 weeks. Single-label audit: bias +1.8pp, coverage 87%.
claims.post_change: Add: audit labeller mistakes bias the estimate upward — send disagreements to a second blind labeller.

claims.claim: On look-alike twins the classifier is confidently wrong.
claims.evidence: match-strength router: 41% of twin errors at ≥0.9; calibrated classifier: 1%. Twin pairs are 88% of errors in both.
claims.post_change: Rewrite: true when confidence is a match-strength score; a calibrated or margin-based score sees twins.

claims.claim: Raising the global threshold is an expensive way to catch twin errors.
claims.evidence: Auto-passed error at a 33% human-review budget: router: raise threshold 7.4%; router: + twin verifier 6.1%; router: margin confidence 5.0%; calibrated classifier 4.5%.
claims.post_change: Rewrite: a threshold only works if confidence is computed against the runner-up.

claims.claim: A twin-aware verification step beats raising the threshold.
claims.evidence: at 33% review budget: verifier 6.1% vs threshold 7.4%; but margin confidence (5.0%) beats both.
claims.post_change: Lead with 'fix the confidence first', verification second.

claims.claim: Joining overrides to drafts by filename loses and misattributes ground truth.
claims.evidence: default: 32% ambiguous, latest-draft-wins picks the wrong draft 26% of the time; up to 55% ambiguous at 60% generic names / 1000 docs per tenant. ID join: 100%.
claims.post_change: Add: the 'latest draft wins' fallback is worse than ambiguity — it is silently wrong.
